timeline.text: Welcome to Frozen Before a Big Test. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am nervous about this test.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind feels like it is going blank.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am afraid I will forget everything I studied.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep imagining getting the answers wrong.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tense before I have even started.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to feel more prepared than I do.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me believes this test decides everything.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel overwhelmed.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: The pressure is making it hard to think clearly.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let my mind settle before I begin.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A blank moment does not mean I do not know the material.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can trust the studying I already did.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to picture every wrong answer.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release some of this tension.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can take one breath before I read the first question.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This test is one moment, not my whole story.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can support myself instead of pressuring myself.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can meet this test one question at a time.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to show what I know.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can clear enough to think.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to recall what I have learned.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on the question in front of me.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can stay calm enough to concentrate.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can breathe and begin.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not need to be perfect, only present.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I am capable of working through this.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to begin.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
